title: Podkletnov's gravity shielding and a Schauberger/Soviet lineage

tellings.quote:
Yeah, there's this guy Pleenov at the
University of Tampir in Finland who
claims um weight reduction based on
spinning superconductors.

plain: In the 1990s, a researcher named Eugene Podkletnov at the University of Tampere in Finland claimed that objects lost some of their weight when placed near spinning superconductors, which are materials that carry electricity with no resistance. Michels brings this up himself on his podcast, crediting the book The Hunt for Zero Point by the writer Nick Cook, and places Podkletnov in a line of earlier work that runs back through the figure Viktor Schauberger and Soviet research. If the claim held, it would mean a step toward shielding against gravity.
